comment: The four outputs read history[sector + i] with sector clamped to 0 to 3 and i running 0 to 3, so generations 7 to 15 of the sixteen computed are never reachable. Both random jacks are processed through the single member edgeDetectorTrigger, so a rising edge consumed by the rule branch leaves the seed branch seeing a trigger already high. A PulseGenerator array pgenGateOut is declared and never used. The outputs are levels held between clock pulses, not pulses.
